scaling: Separate pollutant training-only arithmetic means and sample standard deviations, repeated in every outer split; predictions inverse-transformed to each physical unit.
covariance: Exact float64 Matern32 isotropic in the frozen state projection, unit base variance; fitted signal/noise variances. IND-SEPARATE uses only each output. IND-SHARED has exactly diagonal output covariance and a common scale estimated from all training responses. MV-SEP estimates a full3x3 output covariance and common scale.
starts: Four complete starts with the same core bounds, tolerances and numerical jitter ladder. Marginal fits give the N-weighted geometric common-scale initialization for both shared and joint fits. Shared fits fix correlation coordinates at zero and use the same nuisance-start schedule as joint fits.
means: Centered-zero working GP mean; the fitted constant is training-only. Conditional predictive variances do not propagate covariance or centering uncertainty. A separately fitted OLS plane supplies the spatial-trend point baseline.
baselines: Training mean, Euclidean nearest neighbour, five-neighbour inverse-distance weighting power2 with zero-distance average, and OLS intercept/x/y plane. These four are point predictors without asserted predictive-density models.
failure: Retain every failed/bound start and fit. A failed joint/shared fit uses the corresponding independent predictor; a failed independent fit uses its training-mean/variance fallback. The frozen data partitions all have at least3 training sites per pollutant.
validation: Use frozen A/B/C outer folds and all buffer multiples. Primary comparison has no selected/tuned model catalogue: every declared model is evaluated once per outer test record. No outer test response enters any fitted parameter, transform or baseline.
instrument_sensitivity: Repeat the same models and folds using the predeclared equal-instrument annual mean. Evaluation also uses that aggregate definition; do not treat different response definitions as identical numerical truth.
uncertainty: Paired spatial-block bootstrap of site-aggregated repeated OOF losses,2000 resamples with all repeats for a site together; coordinate-defined blocks fixed independently of model outcomes. Intervals condition on fitted predictions and do not include refitting uncertainty.
scope: Primary exact/separable models with instrument-definition and buffer sensitivities.
